findings.source: application.rs control callback originally lock_local only; Backend independent OS epoch cancellation added under root authorization, editor wiring pending/finalizing

findings.topic: Foreground leave still deferred to main pump
findings.source: fc-windows/src/host.rs FOREGROUND_MESSAGE uses state.hint rather than control_hint; App checks lesson_foreground_allowed only after main-pump receives hints
findings.effect: A queued/in-flight public write can pass precommit before the main pump consumes external foreground departure
findings.suggestion: Trusted exact allowed-foreground memory guard updated by native control event; do not cancel on every foregroundchange because chooser activation is expected

findings.topic: Unrelated short writer publication closes idle chooser
findings.source: App::poll auto-closes publicflow when guard.is_current false and no pending task; guard public Healthy-only, backend voice maintenance can publish AuthorityUpdating
findings.effect: Active voice/background mutation may close an otherwise valid idle chooser without catalog/schedule change
findings.suggestion: Exclude known transient AuthorityUpdating from automatic permanent close, keep submission gated and recheck original guard after Healthy; actual OS epoch cancellation already prevents SQL

notClaimed: Physical input or human interaction acceptance
